name: PT Arkayana Lestari Grup Tbk
summary: PT Arkayana Lestari Grup Tbk designs, supplies, and installs geosynthetic materials in Indonesia. The company offers products, such as high-tensile woven geotextiles for soil reinforcement, non-woven geotextiles for filtration and drainage, and high-density impermeable geomembranes for water containment. Its services include nationwide distribution and project supply. PT Arkayana Lestari Grup Tbk was formerly known as PT Agro Yasa Lestari Tbk and changed its name to PT Arkayana Lestari Grup Tbk in May 2026. PT Agro Yasa Lestari Tbk was founded in 2010 and is based in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT Arkayana Lestari Grup Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Anugrah Cakrawala Dunia.
